# Accurate Hearing Technology, Inc

> > A comprehensive hearing care provider in Central Florida offering professional hearing tests, custom hearing aids, and audiological expertise for better ear health and quality of life.

Accurate Hearing Technology, Inc (AHT Hearing) is a hearing aid specialist practice with locations in Sanford, Lake Mary, Orlando, and surrounding Central Florida communities. The site provides services including audiometric testing, hearing aid fitting and maintenance, and educational resources on hearing health conditions and device care.

- Sanford, FL
